title: Pack service offerings (OSBAPI-shaped)
description: Optional offerings.yaml in a pack. An offering is a unit a consumer turns on; a plan is one tier of it. Mirrors the Open Service Broker API catalog shape and the OSCAL core mapping in oscal-vault-core (offering = component-definition capability, plan = capability control-implementation, incorporated components = incorporates-components, provided controls = implemented-requirements). Each provided control carries the provider/consumer split that a consuming SSP records as by-component export provided/responsibilities. Candidate capabilities only: a pack never carries an implementation status, which belongs to the consuming system.

incorporates.description: Ids of components in the same pack that back this plan.

control.description: OSCAL-form NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 control or enhancement id, for example ac-2 or ac-2.1.

origination.description: The ControlOrigination enum shared with oscal-vault-core (vault-schemas.json).

provider_does.description: What the offering satisfies on the consumer's behalf (by-component export provided).

consumer_must.description: What the consumer must still do to fully inherit (by-component export responsibilities). Required unless origination is inherited.
